text: Pogačar detonated on Alpe d'Huez's slopes, shredding the climb record and dropping every challenger bar Martinez, who clung to his wheel but finished six seconds adrift. The demolition extends his overall lead over Evenepoel to over seven minutes—a cushion that could prove decisive with one more summit finish looming. Kuss and Carapaz battled for scraps behind, unable to exploit any weakness in a performance that felt less like racing and more like a coronation lap toward a record-equalling fifth yellow jersey.
